displayType.title: Display Type
displayType.helpText: Use vertical when the panel sits in a narrow column, so the filters sit one below another and expand in place instead of opening floating menus.

propertyAllowList.title: Filterable Properties
propertyAllowList.helpText: Restrict the property filters to the groups that matter on this page, for example only colour and size.

auto-fit.label: Auto fit
auto-fit.description: Automatically fits as many columns as possible.

max-content.label: Max content
max-content.description: Size columns based on their maximum content size.

explicit.label: Explicit
explicit.description: Use explicit columns and rows configuration.

thumbnailNavShowsMediaOnHover.title: Navigate on hover
thumbnailNavShowsMediaOnHover.helpText: Accessibility: when active, the gallery switches media on hover alone, without any click. This could be triggered by accident.

activeId.title: Active category ID
activeId.helpText: Filled automatically on a category page — leave this as it is.

displayType.title: Display type
displayType.helpText: 'Static' renders the tree as it is. 'Collapse' adds a plus button to every category whose sub-levels are rendered, so shoppers can open them. That mode renders the whole tree down to the navigation depth of the sales channel, which makes every page carrying the element heavier on a deep catalogue.

expandAll.title: Expand all
expandAll.helpText: When off, only the branch leading to the current category is expanded. When on, the tree expands to the navigation depth configured on the sales channel. In collapse mode this sets which branches start open.

ariaLabel.title: Accessible label
ariaLabel.helpText: Helps screen reader users tell this navigation apart from others on the page.

itemSizing.title: Item Sizing
itemSizing.helpText: Fixed keeps a fixed product card width and allows overlapping cards. Fit sizes the cards so a whole number of columns fills the available width.

scrollBehaviour.title: Scroll Behaviour
scrollBehaviour.helpText: Snap locks the slider to the start of a product card. Natural stops the slider wherever scrolling ends.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.helpText: Fill gives every tab the space its title needs, justified gives every tab the same width.
